    About this item

    • Dimensions: Sleeve Length from Shoulder- 30 inches, Chest- 52 inches, Length- 46 inches. Ideal fit for Shirt size (L)
    • Material: Made from High Quality Polyester fabric, durable and long lasting.
    • Construction: This Reversible Use Rainwear is made from good quality Polyester fabric. Every joint is seam sealed with additional leak proof stitching making it completely waterproof. Overlaying flap with snap buttons over zippers prevents water seepage. It also comes with high collars, adjustable hood, elastics on sleeves for added protection. Inner pocket to protect mobile or any other expensive items. Side cross pockets as added utility. Additional waist strap for a smarter look.
    • Safety: Back reflective stripe assure safety while travelling in low lighting.
    • Storage: Available with bag for easy storage. Can comfortably carry in your backpack or your bike storage compartment for handy use
